_doc: PLAN.md 5.3, §4.8. Encounter level 1-100 is the one difficulty axis. An encounter spends a budget of enemy tiles (a ship costs its tile count, so big ships cost more): base + per_level x level^power. The level's band says which tiers come and how often (weights; a tier none of whose ships fit the level is skipped), how many enemies (count [min, max]), and damage: the share of their guns' damage enemies deal, so early fights don't melt a starter ship. Enemy guns are level x gun_level.per_level, give or take gun_level.spread (a share), within 1-999 (§4.8). A Kill HVT encounter (12.2) brings the boss whose levels fit, and it counts toward the budget.

waves._doc: PLAN.md 8.1, WaveTime. Wave n is a generated fight at levels[n-1]; past the list each wave adds then_per_wave, up to 100. The next wave comes wave_s after the last one came in, or clear_pause_s after every enemy is down, whichever is first. First pass, tuned in 8.7 (run 1 should last 1-2 minutes).
